title: The Hidden Costs of AI Inference Storage
excerpt: While many executives focus on GPUs and power, data storage costs from AI inference are often overlooked.
body_html:
When considering the financial impact of artificial intelligence, leadership often focuses heavily on hardware requirements like GPUs, power consumption, and silicon waitlists. However, this perspective frequently overlooks the expenses associated with data storage.

Following a model response, a significant amount of back-end data is generated. This includes billions of everyday prompts, along with various images and videos, which require ongoing management and retention.
